Method of Attack: Remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities exploitable by subscribers and contributors allowing execution of arbitrary PHP code
Exploitation via shortcode parameter, plugin’s metabox, and Gutenberg blocks
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using PHP Everywhere plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation by logged-in users with subscriber or contributor roles
Sending crafted requests with shortcode parameter
Adding PHP code metabox and previewing post
Adding PHP Everywhere Gutenberg blocks with edit_posts capability
